title: Self-assembly of high-nuclearity lanthanide-based nanoclusters for potential bioimaging applications

synthesis.procedure: Under the generally stated dry, oxygen-free dinitrogen atmosphere, Cd(OAc)2·2H2O and NdCl3·6H2O were dissolved in MeOH at room temperature. H2L and Et3N in EtOH were added; the solution was stirred under reflux for 30 min, cooled and filtered. Diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse into the filtrate at room temperature. Crystals formed after two weeks, were filtered, washed with EtOH and dried in air.
solvents: EtOH (10 mL for Et3N; 5 mL wash)
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for mixing and crystallization; reflux for 30 min
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Reflux followed by diethyl-ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool, filter, diffuse diethyl ether into filtrate; filter pale-yellow crystals, wash with EtOH and dry in air.

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Nd(III) near-infrared emission was observed in acetonitrile.

measurements.name: Calculated intrinsic quantum yield
measurements.conditions: Nd(III) emission; calculated using a 250 µs natural lifetime
